questions.text:
A right triangle has acute angle \(\theta\) with
   \[
   \tan\theta+\cot\theta=4.
   \]
   Find the exact value of \(\sin\theta+\cos\theta\).

Two observers stand on the same straight road on opposite sides of a tower. Their distances from the tower differ by \(40\) m, and the angles of elevation to the top are \(45^\circ\) and \(30^\circ\). Find the height of the tower.

Without a calculator, determine the exact value of
   \[
   \left(\sec 30^\circ-\tan 30^\circ\right)\left(\sec 30^\circ+\tan 30^\circ\right)
   +\left(\csc 45^\circ-\cot 45^\circ\right)^2.
   \]
In a right triangle, the altitude from the right angle to the hypotenuse divides the hypotenuse into segments of lengths \(1\) and \(4\). Find the exact value of the triangle’s perimeter.
A balloon is vertically above a straight road. The angles of depression to two mileposts on the same side of the balloon are \(45^\circ\) and \(30^\circ\). How high is the balloon above the road?

questions.text: An observer looking at the top of a radio tower measures an angle of elevation of $15^\circ$. After walking exactly $100$ meters directly toward the tower on level ground, the angle of elevation increases to $30^\circ$. Mentally compute the exact height of the tower in meters.

questions.text:
Without using a calculator, determine the exact numerical value of the expression: 
$(\sin 15^\circ + \cos 15^\circ)^2$

questions.source_label: Chapter 5.2 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q3
questions.text: Given that $\sec \theta + \tan \theta = 5$ for an acute angle $\theta$, mentally evaluate the exact value of $\sec \theta - \tan \theta$.

questions.source_label: Chapter 5.2 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q4
questions.text:
Exploit the symmetries of the right triangle to evaluate the following sum entirely in your head:
$\cos^2 10^\circ + \cos^2 20^\circ + \cos^2 30^\circ + \cos^2 40^\circ + \cos^2 50^\circ + \cos^2 60^\circ + \cos^2 70^\circ + \cos^2 80^\circ$

questions.source_label: Chapter 5.2 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q5
questions.text:
Using the definitions of the trigonometric ratios, find the exact value of the following 89-term product:
$\tan 1^\circ \cdot \tan 2^\circ \cdot \tan 3^\circ \cdots \tan 88^\circ \cdot \tan 89^\circ$

questions.source_label: Chapter 5.2 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q6
questions.text: In a right triangle with acute angles $\alpha$ and $\beta$, it is known that $\log_2(\sin \alpha) + \log_2(\cos \alpha) = -2$. Mentally determine the degree measures of both $\alpha$ and $\beta$.
